independent_tests.command: taskset -c16,17 nice -n19 env OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 PYTHONPATH=<worktree> /usr/bin/python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_bt4_derived_wdl_sidecar.py

checks: LCM block boundaries preserve original batch start/end, row order and tail
Fallback preserves original reads when alignment exceeds cap
STOP/resource guard still called before each inference batch
Final whole-source storage identity and source summary guards unchanged
Fake-session producer verifies exact inputs, requested outputs, metadata and output arrays with original read-loop control
No persistent cache or accumulated batch retention on production path
limitations: 2048 is per-read/read-ahead cap, not44MiB peak process memory. Previous yielded views and new buffer can coexist at rollover; decoder/feed temporaries also exist. Production residency stays bounded.
Benchmark measures source reads and CPU feed/digest preparation on one warm/cache-uncontrolled NVMe/ZIP shard; no actual model inference or end-to-end GPU throughput measurement.
Producer identity records new source code hash; fake-session metadata equality compares read strategies under the same new producer code identity.
